purpose: Evaluate English strong VPC and VID occurrence identification on fixed train/dev/test splits; never use this Web-review corpus as a lexical-coverage reference distribution.

projection.source_layer: strong MWEs in each sentence's smwes object
projection.discontinuous_rule: max(toknums) - min(toknums) + 1 is greater than len(toknums)
excluded: literal negative candidates and contextual idiomaticity labels

expected_surface_baseline.algorithm: casefolded contiguous token-lemma matching of train target types; most frequent train category with lexical tie-break

scoring.project_checker: scripts/check_streusle_v5.py provides target-only exact-span and exact-span-plus-category scores for its declared surface baseline
scoring.official_evaluator: streuseval.py from the same v5.0 checkout remains the independent all-STREUSLE evaluator
primary_claims: target-only exact strong-expression identification precision, recall, and F1
target-only exact span-plus-category precision, recall, and F1
all-type link and token-tag diagnostics only when the official evaluator is run separately
seen and unseen lexlemma strata reported separately by this profile
prohibited_claims: STREUSLE validates lexical coverage, L2 proficiency, or pedagogical importance
STREUSLE supersenses equal OEWN fine-grained senses
a score on Web reviews generalizes to learner writing or other registers
the project-authored supplied-candidate evaluator measures automatic span detection

rights.source_sentence_and_ptb_notice: The upstream README says source sentences and PTB annotations are redistributed with permission of Google and the Linguistic Data Consortium, respectively.
rights.reason_not_bundled: Keep upstream source-text permissions and ShareAlike packaging intact; researchers obtain the exact free tagged release and run the local checker offline.
